verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm whose product surface is a self-service library of legal forms, document generators, health-check questionnaires and client portals, not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in to use their tools is therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Orrick ships an agent or any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
